0.name: Spy

1.name: Guard
1.text: Name a rank other than Guard and pick an opponent. If they're holding that rank, they're out.

2.name: Priest
2.text: Privately look at another player's hand.

3.name: Baron
3.text: Privately compare hands with another player. Whoever holds the lower rank is out.

4.name: Handmaid
4.text: You can't be targeted by any card effect until your next turn.

5.name: Prince
5.text: Pick any player, including yourself. They discard their hand and draw a new card.

6.name: Chancellor
6.text: Draw two cards, then return two of your three cards to the bottom of the deck in an order you choose, keeping one.

8.name: Countess
8.text: You must discard this card if your other card is the King or the Prince.

9.name: Princess
9.text: If you discard this card for any reason, you're out.

cana.title: Small beer
flavor: Cold, small and perfect.
The first of the day always goes down on its own.
Two hundred millilitres of nothing. That is what you tell yourself.
The glass is sweating more than you are.
Drunk at the bar without sitting down.
You order one and three arrive.

tinto.title: Summer red
flavor: Wine and lemonade. It is fooling nobody.
What you order when you do not want another beer.
Tastes like a Sunday afternoon.
There is a slice of lemon nobody eats.
Half a jug in and the sun stops bothering you.

clara.title: Shandy
flavor: Half a step back. Only half.
The drink of somebody who says they are stopping.
It counts as water if you do not think about it.

pinta.title: Pint
flavor: Like the small one, but twice it, twice as fast.
It arrives in a glass with actual weight to it.
It goes warm before you reach the bottom.
They pour these because the tourists cannot order properly.

vino.title: Glass of wine
flavor: Somebody attempting class at four in the afternoon.
The list had two options and this was the expensive one.
Served far too cold and nobody minds.
Drunk looking at the sea as though you knew about wine.

vermut.title: Vermouth
flavor: Ice, orange, and an olive nobody wanted.
Vermouth hour lasts six hours.
The house one, which is the barrel one.

sangria.title: Jug of sangria
flavor: Fruit floating on top of something that is not wine.
Four straws and no conversation.
The jug is more ice than anything else.

mojito.title: Mojito
flavor: Mint in your teeth for the rest of the afternoon.
So much sugar you cannot find the rum.
Made in thirty seconds and it shows.

cubata.title: Rum and coke
flavor: Two fingers of mixer and the rest is not.
Plastic glass, filled right to the top.
You did not see which bottle he reached for.
It tastes different every time and it is always the same.
With a short straw that does not reach the bottom.
The barman puts it down before you order anything.
The ice gave up a while ago.

chupito.title: Shot
flavor: One. Just one. It is never one.
After three, and nobody counts to three.
A colour that does not occur in nature.
Drunk purely so as not to look rude.

gintonic.title: Gin and tonic
flavor: In a balloon glass, because they do it properly here.
With cucumber. You do not know why there is cucumber.
Eight euros and you pay it without a word.
The barman stirs it as though it mattered.
Half the glass is ice and it is still eight euros.

coctel.title: Cocktail
flavor: Comes with a paper umbrella and four things that do not go together.
From the laminated menu, second one down.
Ordered for the photo and good anyway.

jager.title: Jägermeister
flavor: Tastes like cough syrup and everybody loves it.
Out of that tap that is always freezing.
The bloke next to you has already ordered another.
Nobody decided this. It just happened.

cargada.title: Stiff one
flavor: You told him not to be shy and he was not shy.
The mixer is in there for the colour.
You get it down in two and say nothing.

hierbas.title: Herbal liqueur
flavor: Mallorcan, sweet and treacherous.
The owner pours it and you cannot say no.
Tastes of boiled sweets and the end of the night.

tequila3.title: Tequila
flavor: Salt, shot, lime. In that order, roughly.
By this hour nobody bothers with the salt.
The bottle has been out on the bar all night.
Three in a row, because one makes no sense.

absenta.title: Absinthe
flavor: They set fire to it, which should tell you something.
Green, with burnt sugar on the top.
Nobody at this table knows what is in it.

garrafon.title: Bootleg spirit
flavor: The bottle has no label and the price explains why.
You will remember this tomorrow. Vividly.

pecera.title: Fishbowl
flavor: A litre and a half, five straws and no accountability.
It takes two barmen to carry and the whole bar looks.

agua.title: Water
flavor: The single most intelligent decision you will make today.

itemDesc.kebab: Kebab — soak it up. Removes 3 Intoxication.
itemDesc.redbull: Red Bull — look at tonight's limit. Only you see it, and only until the day ends.
itemDesc.porro: Joint — skip your turn without drinking and without withdrawing, and step outside for a smoke: until your next turn you're out of the venue for every purpose — the ambulance, forced rounds, searches and raids can't reach you, and you don't count for karaoke or collect party bonuses either. Contraband: searches cost points, raids mean jail.
itemDesc.pastis: MDMA — your next drink is worth double points. Contraband: searches cost points, raids mean jail.
itemDesc.farlopa: Cocaine — drink an extra card at half Intoxication, and take 3 Hangover. Contraband: searches cost points, raids mean jail.

ligueTardeo.title: Poolside pull
flavor: Better than nothing.
They told you their name and it is already gone.

fiestaTardeo.title: Beach bar
flavor: Two speakers and a cool box. Nothing else required.
The barman knows your order and you have been here an hour.

peleaTardeo.title: Tourist bickering
flavor: Nothing serious. All shoving, no actual punches.
Broken up by two barmen and an inflatable flamingo.

chungoTardeo.title: Phone in the sea
flavor: Rice is not going to fix this one.
You watch it go down. Slowly. Very clearly.

insolacion.title: Sunstroke
flavor: Six hours drinking in the sun. Nobody warned you.
You will have the sunglasses tan line until Sunday.

foto.title: Photo for the feed
flavor: Forty attempts for one that works.
Your eyes are shut in it and you post it anyway.

barraLibreTardeo.title: Poolside open bar
barraLibreTardeo.effect: Gain <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp> for every drink you have had this phase.
flavor: A paper wristband and sangria from a jug until nine.

ligueNoche.title: Dancefloor pull
flavor: Neither of you can hear a thing, but it lands.
Half an hour of dancing and not one word exchanged.

fiestaNoche.title: Foam party
flavor: It has got in everywhere. Everywhere.
You lose a trainer and do not miss it until morning.

peleaNoche.title: Fight
flavor: You no longer remember how it started.
You were defending someone you had just met.
You won. According to you.

chungoNoche.title: Pickpocketed
chungoNoche.effect: Choose: pay them off, or lose everything you are carrying.
flavor: Three very friendly lads until ten seconds ago.
You did not even notice. The doorman tells you.

gorila.title: Thrown out by the bouncer
gorila.effect: You leave the phase, with no penalty.
flavor: He does not say why. There is no why.
He lifts you off the floor without breaking a sweat.

garrafonEvent.title: Served bootleg
flavor: That is not gin. That has never been gin.
Tastes like a swimming pool and costs four euros.
The label on the bottle is on upside down.

barraLibreNoche.title: Club open bar
barraLibreNoche.effect: Gain <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp> for every drink you have had this phase.
flavor: Twenty euros and plastic cups until three.
The queue is longer than the bar.

ligueAfter.title: Afterparty pull
flavor: Nobody will remember. Including you.
You told each other everything. None of it survived.

fiestaAfter.title: Sunrise on the beach
flavor: The sun comes up and nobody wants to leave.
Eight strangers, one towel and a speaker out of battery.

peleaAfter.title: Fight with the bouncers
flavor: Bad idea. Everyone knew that except you.
There are three of them and none has blinked.
You end up on the kerb explaining it to a lamppost.

chungoAfter.title: You wake up with nothing
chungoAfter.effect: Lose <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp> and all your items.
flavor: Pockets inside out and no idea when.
You had a bum bag. You are certain you had a bum bag.

soloVoyAMirar.title: Just going to look
flavor: You step out onto the balcony for a second. One second.
You can see the whole promenade from up here.
You are only looking. That is what you said.

terraza.title: The fifth-floor terrace
terraza.effect: Choose: go up, or stay downstairs.
flavor: The best party of the trip, five floors up.
You can hear it from the street and there is no lift.

comaEtilico.title: Alcohol poisoning
flavor: You are no longer at the party even though you are at the party.
Somebody is talking to you very slowly.

barraLibreAfter.title: Afterparty open bar
barraLibreAfter.effect: Gain <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp> for every drink you have had this phase.
flavor: Nobody is charging for anything any more.
All that is left is ice and a bottle with no label.

karaoke.title: Karaoke
karaoke.effect: Gain <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp>, doubled if you are the most intoxicated at the table.
flavor: You know the words. You do not know the song.
Nobody asked for an encore and you are on your third.

perdido.title: You get lost
perdido.effect: You miss your next turn, but stay in the party.
flavor: Every street here is the same street.
You have spent twenty minutes following a group you do not know.

chupitoCasa.title: House shot
flavor: On the house. The house always insists.
It is blue. Do not ask what of.
One for you and one for the barman.
It appeared on the bar and nobody ordered it.

ronda.title: Round of drinks
ronda.effect: Everyone still partying drinks an alcohol card.
flavor: You are paying. You said so yourself.
Nobody remembers whose round it was.
Eight drinks and two hands.

vomitona.title: You feel it coming up
vomitona.effect: Choose: let it out, or hold it in.
flavor: It was the bootleg. It was definitely the bootleg.
You have gone very quiet all of a sudden.

ambulancia.title: Ambulance
ambulancia.effect: The most intoxicated player withdraws, with <relief>{{relief}} Intoxication</relief> and <resaca>+3 Hangover</resaca>.
flavor: The crew have already been to this hotel tonight.
They walk him out, which is the good version.

kebabEvent.title: Kebab
flavor: The one on the corner that never closes.
Eaten standing up and the best thing all trip.

aguaEvent.title: Bottle of water
flavor: Somebody sensible put it in your hand.
It is warm. It does not matter.

redbullEvent.title: Red Bull
flavor: Second wind, bought at a petrol station.
At this hour it counts as breakfast.

cacheo.title: Stop-and-search
cacheo.effect: Everyone holding contraband discards it and loses <vp>−3 VP</vp> per item.
flavor: Against the wall, hands where they can see them.

redada.title: Police raid
redada.effect: Everyone holding contraband spends the night in a cell.
flavor: Two vans and no hurry at all.
The music stops before the people do.

nada.title: Nothing happens
flavor: For once, nothing. Enjoy it.

colecta.title: The whip-round
colecta.effect: Whoever is having the worst weekend takes <vp>+6 VP</vp> straight to the bank.
flavor: They have a collection without telling him.
Everyone puts in two euros and it is never mentioned again.

remontada.title: The comeback
remontada.effect: The player in last place is handed back half of what the leader is up on them, straight to the bank.
flavor: The weekend is not over until it is over.
One night left and the face of somebody not finished.

camelloPorro.title: Dealer
camelloPorro.effect: Choose: take a <item>Joint</item>, or leave it.
flavor: He turns up exactly when nobody was looking for him.
He keeps it in his cap. Everyone knows.

camelloPastis.title: Dealer
flavor: He shows you his palm and closes it again straight away.
He says it is the good stuff. They all say that.
He has not named a price and you are already thinking about it.

camelloFarlopa.title: Dealer
flavor: He walks you to the toilets without asking if you are coming.
He talks very fast for the one doing the selling.
At this hour he does not need to push it any more.

ultimaRonda.title: Last round
ultimaRonda.effect: Choose: sink it now, or promise them tomorrow.
flavor: Somebody puts a drink in your hand without asking.
They close in ten minutes and they are still pouring.

resacon.title: Rough one
resacon.effect: Choose: sit still and sleep some of it off, or carry on.
flavor: You could stop. It costs you, but you could.
There is a sofa and it is looking right at you.

invitacion.title: You are owed a favour
invitacion.effect: Choose: take the cash, or take the food.
flavor: You lent it to him on Thursday and he had forgotten.

dobleONada.title: Double or nothing
dobleONada.effect: Choose: one more drink worth twice as much, or pass.
flavor: Nobody is making you. Nobody is going to stop you either.

saltarLaCola.title: Queue-jump
saltarLaCola.effect: Choose: leave now and abandon the phase, or stay where you are.
flavor: A big night is starting elsewhere and you would go now.
You know the doorman. He says now or not at all.

dueloTardeo.title: Beach bar duel
dueloTardeo.effect: Choose: challenge someone to a drinking duel, or leave it. Whoever holds out takes <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp>, plus <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp> for every drink in the duel.
flavor: First one to order water buys the round.

dueloNoche.title: Duel at the bar
dueloNoche.effect: Choose: challenge someone to a drinking duel, or leave it. Whoever holds out takes <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp>, plus <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp> for every drink in the duel.
flavor: Nobody remembers how it started. Nobody's backing down.
The barman has stopped asking.

dueloAfter.title: Duel at dawn
dueloAfter.effect: Choose: challenge someone to a drinking duel, or leave it. Whoever holds out takes <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp>, plus <vp>{{vp}} VP</vp> for every drink in the duel.
flavor: The sun's coming up, and only one of you is going to see it.
Ten paces. With glasses.
